metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the macos-def:nvram512_test is properly supported
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the macos-def:nvram512_test.

notes.note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

criterion.comment: Test that the nvram_object can find the nvram_var entity equal to 94b73556-2197-4702-82a8-3e1337dafbfb:AppleSecureBootPolicy.
Test that the nvram512_object is supported with the variable entity equal to some non-existent value.
Test that the nvram512_object is supported with the variable entity not equal to some value.
Test that the nvram512_object is supported with the variable entity matching some regular expression.

nvram512_test.comment: Test that the nvram512_object is supported with the variable entity equal to some value.
Test that the nvram512_object is supported with the variable entity equal to some value that does not exist.
Test that the nvram512_object is supported with the variable entity not equal to some value.
Test that the nvram512_object is supported with the variable entity matching some regular expression.

nvram512_object.comment: This object represents a nvram512_object with the nvram variable name equal to '94b73556-2197-4702-82a8-3e1337dafbfb:AppleSecureBootPolic'.
This object represents a nvram512_object with the nvram variable name equal to 'foobar'.
This object represents a nvram512_object with the nvram variable name not equal to 'SystemAudioVolume'.
This object represents a nvram512_object with the nvram variable name matching the regular expression '^efi-'.

nvram512_state.comment: This nvram512_state represents an nvram512_item which has a nvram variable name equal to 'SystemAudioVolume' and a nvram value that matches the regular expression '.*'.
This nvram512_state represents nvram512_items which have a nvram variable name not equal to 'SystemAudioVolume' and a nvram value that matches the regular expression '.*'.
This nvram512_state represents nvram512_items which have a nvram variable name that matches the regular expression '^efi-' and a nvram value that matches the regular expression '.*'.
